a11374479d4937e054cfab8e6ef25b4152a29ad7.summary: This is a Kubernetes documentation page describing the CronJob resource, which starts Jobs on a repeating cron-style schedule. It covers schedule syntax, deadlines for late starts, concurrency policies, suspension, job history limits, time zones and known limitations. It contains no threat, actor, malware, vulnerability or incident content, so it is not a threat report.

a147a8909bbbed7c46e1d99107785f789845c224.summary: FireEye Mandiant describes an unnamed actor that exploits Citrix NetScaler devices using CVE-2019-19781. The actor removes other known malware and deploys the NOTROBIN utility, which deletes competing exploit files while keeping a backdoor reachable with a secret key. FireEye believes this may be preparation for a later campaign. Nearly 100 hardcoded keys were recovered and are withheld. The report was published on 15 January 2020.
